description:
While casually watching adult videos, a high school student named Kang Yi-jun realizes that the woman in the video is Bae Su-yeon, a married woman who lives next door. 

From that day on, he goes to her and begins blackmailing her, asking, “Can I show this to your husband?” 

Though Su-yeon resists out of shame and fear, she eventually breaks down. Gradually, she becomes addicted to the pleasure derived from this blackmail, surrendering herself and descending into depravity.
